item.description: when EAP runs with -secmgr, the openjdk-orb's JDKBridge honours attacker-supplied CDR codebase URLs during object unmarshalling on :3528, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to load and instantiate arbitrary classes from a remote URL in the server JVM before EJB security interceptors run.

item.title: [HIGH] CVE-2026-15556: A flaw was found in Picketlink's SP signature validation; a SAML response contai...
item.description: A flaw was found in Picketlink's SP signature validation; a SAML response containing zero assertion elements matching the signature check can allow an attacker to forge a SAML response and auth as any principal with any roles on the protected application.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-15555: A flaw was found in JBoss marshalling. The Infinispan session replication path d...
item.description: A flaw was found in JBoss marshalling. The Infinispan session replication path deserializes replicated session data via the JBoss Marshalling River unmarshaller with no class filtering — enabling RCE via deserialization gadget chains on every cluster node.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-15554: the Undertow AJP listener honours forged ssl_cert and is_ssl AJP attributes with...
item.description: the Undertow AJP listener honours forged ssl_cert and is_ssl AJP attributes without requiring any shared-secret authentication. This enables an unauthenticated attacker with direct TCP access to port 8009 to bypass CLIENT-CERT authentication by injecting a forged X.509 certificate via the AJP protocol.

item.title: [MEDIUM] CVE-2026-10579: A flaw was found in Picketlink Federation SAML; the unsolcited response handler ...
item.description: A flaw was found in Picketlink Federation SAML; the unsolcited response handler would accept forged assertions with no verification or validation, permitting an unauthed attacker to authenticate as any principal in any role. This could lead to information disclosure, access to restricted operations, or other flaws.
